text: I have never seen so many people agree about a table before.
We walked past the same door four times and it looked different every time.
The first attempt failing in front of everybody was the best thing that happened all week.
Most of the week went into building the thing that holds the other thing.
Nobody asked me what I do for a living. It took me two days to notice.
Cooking for strangers is easier than cooking for friends. There is less to prove.
I came for one evening and stayed for four days.
Twelve people now know how it is made. That is the whole point.
